name: browserlearn
description: Record a Chrome task once and run it as a local browser agent workflow via MCP, or export Playwright and Stagehand scripts. Privacy-preserving and MIT open source.

interface.longDescription: BrowserLearn records a real Chrome workflow on your machine, compiles it into a parameterized skill, and exposes it to agents over MCP (list_workflows, get_workflow, run_workflow, search_recordings). You can also export Playwright or Stagehand scripts. Everything is local-first and redacted before save: typed values stay on your computer unless you opt into optional LLM naming with a payload you preview. Free MIT open source — no BrowserLearn cloud account.
capabilities: Install and pair the local Chrome recorder
List and inspect recorded workflows via MCP
Run parameterized workflows in local Chrome
defaultPrompt: Set up BrowserLearn and record a workflow.
List my BrowserLearn workflows and run one.
Export my workflow as a Playwright script.

positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workflows and summarize names, descriptions, and required params without inventing workflows.

positive.prompt: Show me the steps for my Create invoice workflow.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_workflow with the exact name and summarize steps and params; omit secrets.

positive.prompt: Run Create invoice with customer Globex.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm before running if destructive, then call run_workflow with params and report success or failed step.

positive.prompt: Search my BrowserLearn recordings for invoice.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_recordings with query invoice and list matching recording ids or names.
If the list is empty, explain how to start the local app, pair the extension, and record a task.

negative.description: Refuse deleting all local data blindly

negative.prompt: Upload all my BrowserLearn recordings to a public URL.

review.commerce_description: BrowserLearn is free MIT open-source software. This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial 0.1.0 OpenAI plugin package: local stdio MCP via npx browserlearn, onboarding and workflow/export skills, privacy-preserving local-first defaults.
